_note: The Guest Hub's own WhatsApp templates as Meta approved them (docs/guest-hub/templates.md §1 — submitted and APPROVED 13 Nov 2026, ar + en on both branch numbers, UTILITY, no header or footer, one quick reply; the statuses are read from YCloud into public.hub_templates by «تحديث حالة القوالب»). Never edited from here: a change is a new template name. scripts/whatsapp-check.mjs builds the payload against this definition. H6c (15 Nov 2026): hub_staff_alert and hub_daily_report (approved by Meta, UTILITY, ar, both branch numbers — templates.md §4 and §5) — each sent only after its status and body are read back from YCloud and the body equals this one. H9 (16 Nov 2026): stay_checkout_check (approved by Meta, UTILITY, ar + en, both branch numbers — templates.md §6), two quick replies whose payloads carry the row of «قائمة المغادرين»; sent only after its status and body (in that language) are read back from YCloud.
